description: One case: dates, disposition, trial, verdict and offer amounts, its motion rulings, and the judges, attorneys and law firms by side.

purpose.description: One sentence on what you are trying to find out. Logged to improve the dataset; never returned.

name: get_case

attorneys.description: Attorneys who appeared, with their juris numbers for get_attorney.

name.description: Name; null when the registry has none.

side.description: Side the attorney appeared for: plaintiff or defendant.

acceptedOfferCents.description: Amount of the offer of compromise that was accepted, in cents; null when none was accepted or the amount is unknown.

arbitrationNetAwardCents.description: Net court-annexed arbitration award, in cents, when one was read from the award.

caseType.description: Court case type code: V01 driver or passenger vs driver, V04 pedestrian vs driver, V09 other motor-vehicle torts.

daysToDisposition.description: Days from filing to disposition; null while pending.

defenseJurisNumber.description: Juris number of the defense side's lead law firm.

dispositionCategory.description: How the case ended, grouped from the court disposition text; null while pending. damages_hearing is a judgment after a hearing that only set damages, usually after a default, not a trial.

dispositionDate.description: Date of disposition; null while pending.

dispositionJudgeKey.description: Key of the judge who decided the disposition, when a judge did.

district.description: Judicial district the case is filed in, e.g. HARTFORD JD.

litigationType.description: third_party (injured person vs at-fault driver), um_uim (claim against own uninsured/underinsured motorist carrier), subrogation (insurer suing to recover what it paid).

netVerdictCents.description: Net jury verdict for the plaintiff after comparative negligence, in cents; null without a plaintiff or mixed jury verdict whose amount was read.

officialUrl.description: The case on the Connecticut Judicial Branch civil inquiry site, the official record.

plaintiffJurisNumber.description: Juris number of the plaintiff side's lead law firm.

splitOutcome.description: True when defendants in the same case reached different outcomes.

trialDate.description: Trial date recorded on the docket.

trialDeNovoDemanded.description: True when either side demanded a trial de novo after arbitration.

trialKind.description: jury or court when the case was tried to a verdict or decision; null otherwise.

name.description: Judge name; null when the key has no registered name.

dispositionJudge.description: The judge who decided the disposition; null when no judge did.

firms.description: Lead law firm on each side; null when none is known.

name.description: Name; null when the registry has none.
Name; null when the registry has none.

daysToRuling.description: Days from filing the motion to the ruling.

name.description: Judge name; null when the key has no registered name.

judge.description: The judge who ruled, when known.

opposed.description: Whether an objection to the motion was filed.

outcome.description: Ruling outcome: granted, denied, partial, off, order, withdrawn…

title: Case details
